title.narrative: Anticipatory Multipurpose Cash Assistance for Flood-Prone Households in Adamawa State

description.narrative: ltpgtltspangtThe Centre for Advocacy, Transparency, and Accountability Initiative (CATAI) proposes a lifesaving Multipurpose Cash Assistance (MPCA) intervention targeting 2,730 vulnerable households (approximately 16,380 individuals) in Demsa, Numan, and Lamurde LGAs of Adamawa State—three of the most flood-prone areas along the Benue River. The project is part of the NHF 2025 First Reserve Allocation for anticipatory action, directly aligned with the 2025 Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan (HNRP), aiming to mitigate the humanitarian impact of predicted riverine flooding.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspangtltbrgtlt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtThese communities face a compounded crisis of protracted displacement, deteriorating infrastructure, and worsening food insecurity—especially among female-headed households, persons with disabilities, and the elderly. With the Nigeria Hydrological Services Agency forecasting severe flooding in 2025, pre-emptive, forecast-based action is essential to reduce the scale of post-disaster humanitarian needs.ltbrgtThis project delivers one-off MPCA transfers to enable households to meet urgent needs before flooding peaks. Transfers will be delivered through secure hybrid mechanisms—bank transfers and prepaid smart cards—ensuring accessibility, flexibility, and beneficiary dignity. The cash value aligns with the latest Cash Working Group (CWG) Minimum Expenditure Basket (MEB) at $131.12 (₦208,200) per household.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThe intervention comprises a comprehensive package of preparedness and delivery components:lt/pgtltulgtltligtTargeting and registration leveraging the Adamawa State social register and community validation to ensure accuracy and equity.lt/ligtltligtTraining of 30 enumerators on humanitarian principles, data ethics, and protection to ensure inclusive, dignified engagement during data collection.lt/ligtltligtFormal engagement with Financial Service Providers (FSPs) to facilitate timely, secure cash transfers through hybrid modalities.lt/ligtltligtCommunity sensitization campaigns and IEC materials to educate over 23,000 people on project objectives, eligibility, assistance modalities, and complaint systems.lt/ligtltligtJoint Market Monitoring Initiative (JMMI) to assess market readiness, price stability, and availability of key goods, ensuring effective MPCA planning and response.lt/ligtltligtRobust accountability mechanisms including 3 community help desks, CFM volunteers, and a toll-free, IVR-enabled hotline for real-time complaint handling.lt/ligtltligtPost-distribution monitoring (PDM) to assess the appropriateness, effectiveness, and satisfaction with the assistance provided, enabling adaptive learning.lt/ligtlt/ulgtltpgtThe project mainstreams critical cross-cutting themes: Protection, AAP, PSEA, Gender Equality, and Disability Inclusion. Vulnerable groups—women-headed households, people with disabilities, the elderly, and those in informal shelters—are prioritized in targeting and service adaptation. CATAI will collaborate with Organizations of Persons with Disabilities (OPDs) to identify and address accessibility barriers.ltbrgtImplementation will be coordinated with SEMA, the Cash Working Group (CWG), the Anticipatory Action Working Group (AAWG), and other actors to ensure strategic coherence and avoid duplication. A detailed risk management framework will guide mitigation across operational, safeguarding, and fiduciary domains, reinforcing safe, accountable delivery.ltbrgtWith the capacity to activate within 5–10 days of early warning triggers, CATAI is positioned for rapid deployment. Its established presence in the target LGAs and prior experience in MPCA delivery enhance its ability to reach affected populations efficiently.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThis anticipatory intervention shifts the paradigm from crisis response to early action, empowering communities with timely, dignified support before disaster strikes. It contributes to reducing mortality, hunger, displacement, and vulnerability, while strengthening household resilience and reinforcing the humanitarian imperative to act early, save lives, and preserve dignity.lt/pgt
